senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (ज्वरति)
To be diseased, to be feverish, &c.

m. (-रः)
Fever, intermitting or continued.
E.
ज्वर to be feverish, affix अच्.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Anti-febrile, febrifuge.
f. (-घ्नी)
1 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.)
2 A potherb, (Chenopocium album.)
E.
ज्वर, and घ्न what destroys.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Febrifuge.
E.
ज्वर, and नाशक what destroys.

mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ)
Febrifuge.
E.
ज्वर, and हन्तृ what destroys; ज्वरहन् (-च्चा).

m. (-ग्निः)
Feverish heat, or the hot paroxysm of fever.
E.
ज्वर fever, and अग्नि fire.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Febrifuge.
m. (-कः)
1 A kind of Nimb from Nepal.
2 Cassia fistula.
E.
ज्वर, and अन्तक what removes.

f. (-हा)
A plant, (Medicago esculenta.)
E.
ज्वर fever, अपहा removing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Febrile, feverish, affected with fever.
E.
ज्वर to be feverish, क्त aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Febrile, feverish, fevered.
E.
ज्वर, and इनि.

r. 1st cl. (ज्वलति,) or with a prefix, r. 10th cl. (प्रज्वलयति)
To shine, to blaze, to flame.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Blazing, shining.
m. (-लः)
Flame, blaze, light.
E.
ज्वल, to blaze, affix अच्; also ज्वाल.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Burning, blazing.
mf. (-लः-ला)
Flame, blaze.
f. (-ला)
Burnt rice.
E.
ज्वल to blaze, affix अण्, fem. affix टाप् or ङीप्.

f. (-का)
Flame.
E.
ज्वल to blaze, affix वुन्.

mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्)
1 Burning, blazing.
2 Shining, radiant, brilliant.
E.
ज्वल to burn, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Burning, blazing.
2 The fire.
m. (-नः)
AGNI, or fire.
E.
ज्वल to blaze, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-श्मा)
The sun-stone.
E.
ज्वलन, and अश्मन् a stone.

mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि)
Blazing with jewels.
m. (-णिः)
A brilliant gem.
E.
ज्वलत्, and मणि a jewel.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
1 Burning, blazing.
2 Radiant.
E.
ज्वल to burn, r. 10th cl. शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Burnt.
2 Blazing, flaming.
E.
ज्वल to flame, affix क्त.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Fiery-eyed, looking angrily or fiercely.
E.
ज्वलित, and नयन the eye; also ज्वलितचक्षुस्, ज्वलितनेत्र, &c.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
1 Burning, flaming.
2 Shining.
E.
ज्वल, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Flaming, blazing.
E.
ज्वाला, and इनि aff.

m. (-ग्निः)
Flame.
E.
ज्वाल, and अग्नि fire.

m. (-ह्वः)
AGNI, or fire.
E.
जाला, and जिह्वा a tongue; whose tongue is flame.

f. (-खी)
A place where subterraneous fires break forth; an object of veneration to the Hindus: a celebrated Jvālāmukhī exists in Lahore, to which pilgrimages are made; the soil abounding with carburetted hydrogen, which takes fire upon coming in contact with the external air; otherwise vents being made, a light is applied to the orifice, and flame being kindled, is fed by the stream of gas that escapes. The tongue of PĀRVATĪ is said to have fallen at this place.
E.
ज्वाला flame, and मुख chief, principal, fem. affix ङीष्.
